notes: Edit this file to tune cost vs quality. Scripts read it at every call.
ladder = ordered list of (model, effort), cheapest first.
categories.<name>.tiers = ladder index for tier 1..5 (first route).
categories.<name>.ceiling = highest ladder index this category may reach on retry.
Effort levels available depend on the model. If a level is not supported, Claude Code uses the nearest one.

tiers.1: Trivial. One step, no judgment. Rename, run a known command, read one file.
tiers.2: Low. Few steps, clear path, one file. Small fix with a known cause.
tiers.3: Mid. Several steps or files. Some judgment. Normal feature slice.
tiers.4: High. Cross-module, unclear cause, edge cases, performance or concurrency.
tiers.5: Critical. Security, data loss risk, architecture, irreversible changes.

explore.desc: Read and search the codebase, summarize findings.

ops.desc: Operate the terminal: install, build, run, git, deploy steps.

code.desc: Implement a feature or a change.

debug.desc: Find the cause of a bug and fix it.

data.desc: SQL, migrations, RLS policies, data pipelines.

depth.desc: Right approach, but incomplete: missed edge cases, partial work, shallow check.

capability.desc: Wrong approach or wrong understanding. More effort on the same model will not help.

review.desc: Worker said done, reviewer rejected it.

environment.desc: Missing tool, dependency, permission, flaky network. Fix the environment, retry the same route once.

spec.desc: Goal or acceptance check is unclear or contradictory. Ask the user. Do not retry.

improver.cost_weights_note: Relative cost per 1k tokens. Only the ratios matter. Update them when prices change.
improver.personal_repo_note: Optional: OWNER/NAME of YOUR private repo. /improve then sends this project's results and lessons there after each cycle.
improver.community_auto_share_note: true = /improve runs community.py submit-community after each cycle, without asking.

community.note: Rules for community/aggregate.py, which tunes these defaults from shared feedback.
